verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Iqtarabatis-saa'atu wanshaqqal-qamar
Wa in yaraw aayatan yu'ridoo wa yaqooloo sihrun mustamirr
Wa kadhdhaboo wattaba'oo ahwaa'ahum wa kullu amrin mustaqirr
Wa laqad jaa'ahum minal-anbaa'i maa feehi muzdajar
Hikmatun baalighatun famaa tughnin-nudhur
Fatawalla anhum yawma yad'ud-daa'i ilaa shay'in nukur
Khushsha'an absaaruhum yakhrujoona minal-ajdaathi ka'annahum jaraadun muntashir
Muhti'eena ilad-daa'i yaqoolul-kaafiroona haadhaa yawmun asir
Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakadhdhaboo abdanaa wa qaaloo majnoonun wazdujir
Fada'aa rabbahu annee maghloobun fantasir
Fafatahnaa abwaabas-samaa'i bimaa'in munhamir
Wa fajjarnal-arda uyoonan faltaqal-maa'u alaa amrin qad qudir
Wa hamalnaahu alaa dhaati alwaahin wa dusur
Tajree bi-a'yuninaa jazaa'an liman kaana kufir
Wa laqad taraknaahaa aayatan fahal min muddakir
Fakayfa kaana adhaabee wa nudhur
Wa laqad yassarnal-qur'aana lidh-dhikri fahal min muddakir
Kadhdhabat aadun fakayfa kaana adhaabee wa nudhur
Innaa arsalnaa alayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirr
Tanzi'un-naasa ka'annahum a'jaazu nakhlin munqa'ir
Fakayfa kaana adhaabee wa nudhur
Wa laqad yassarnal-qur'aana lidh-dhikri fahal min muddakir
Kadhdhabat thamoodu bin-nudhur
Faqaaloo abasharan minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhu innaa idhan lafee dalaalin wa su'ur
A'uulqiyadh-dhikru alayhi min bayninaa bal huwa kadhdhaabun ashir
Saya'lamoona ghadan manil-kadhdhaabul-ashir
Innaa mursilun-naaqati fitnatan lahum fartaqibhum wastabir
Wa nabbi'hum annal-maa'a qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadar
Fanaadaw saahibahum fata'aataa fa-aqar
Fakayfa kaana adhaabee wa nudhur
Innaa arsalnaa alayhim sayhatan waahidatan fakaanoo kahasheemil-muhtazir
Wa laqad yassarnal-qur'aana lidh-dhikri fahal min muddakir
Kadhdhabat qawmu lootin bin-nudhur
Innaa arsalnaa alayhim haasiban illaa aala lootin najjaynaahum bisahar
Ni'matan min indinaa kadhaalika najzee man shakar
Wa laqad andharahum batshatanaa fatamaaraw bin-nudhur
Wa laqad raawadoohu an dayfihi fatamasnaa a'yunahum fadhooqoo adhaabee wa nudhur
Wa laqad sabbahahum bukratan adhaabun mustaqirr
Fadhooqoo adhaabee wa nudhur
Wa laqad yassarnal-qur'aana lidh-dhikri fahal min muddakir
Wa laqad jaa'a aala fir'awnan-nudhur
Kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa kullihaa fa-akhadhnaahum akhdha azeezin muqtadir
Akuffaarukum khayrun min oola'ikum am lakum baraa'atun fiz-zubur
Am yaqooloona nahnu jamee'un muntasir
Sayuhzamul-jam'u wa yuwalloonad-dubur
Balis-saa'atu maw'iduhum was-saa'atu adhaa wa amarr
Innal-mujrimeena fee dalaalin wa su'ur
Yawma yushaboona fin-naari alaa wujoohihim dhooqoo massa saqar
Innaa kulla shay'in khalaqnaahu biqadar
Wa maa amrunaa illaa waahidatun kalamhin bil-basar
Wa laqad ahlaknaa ashyaa'akum fahal min muddakir
Wa kullu shay'in fa-aloohu fiz-zubur
Wa kullu sagheerin wa kabeerin mustatar
Innal-muttaqeena fee jannaatin wa nahar
Fee maq'adi sidqin inda maleekin muqtadir
